subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF SWISS CONFEDERATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1003/26 NOTAMR U0617/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2608031237 C)2611012359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF SWISS CONFEDERATION AUTHORITIES
STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR
OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY
SWISS AIRSPACE, NOTAM A0598/26,
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY
CITIZENS OF SWISS CONFEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AOC
ISSUED BY SWISS AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR
OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXC ACFT IN EMERGENCY,
HUMANITARIAN, SAN FLT, AS WELL AS IN CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION
FOR FLT OPS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF
FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
